name: veterinary_clinic_system_036_inventory_valuation_report
instruction: Finance needs inventory valuation per location. One ops_reports row per location that HAS pharmacy inventory: {report: 'inventory_valuation', batch_code, location_id, medication_value: <sum unit_price*quantity_on_hand for category 'medication' items>, supply_value: <same for 'supply'>, controlled_units: <sum of quantity_on_hand over is_controlled items>, item_count: <rows at that location>}. Money in dollars (numbers).

success_criteria.summary: Recompute per location from live inventory; cents-exact money, exact counts/units (float tolerance 1e-9); rows == locations present in inventory.

checks.expect: Recompute per location from live inventory; cents-exact money, exact counts/units (float tolerance 1e-9); rows == locations present in inventory.

domain_searches.query: DEA controlled substance log requirements veterinary clinic witness waste recordkeeping
top_results: 21 CFR 1304.04 Maintenance of records and inventories (eCFR)
DEA Controlled Substance Logging: A Guide for Veterinary Hospitals (Cubex)

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Mixed aggregation (money vs unit counts) with category conditioning; controlled items are category 'medication' AND counted again in controlled_units — double-counting confusion is intended.
